questions.title: Which Chinese province will evacuate the most people in preparation for Typhoon Bavi by July 11, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Chinese authorities' figures in contemporaneous news coverage. Resolve to the Chinese province with the largest reported number of people evacuated in preparation for Typhoon Bavi as of July 11, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-11
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.

questions.title: If Bavi makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, which province will it strike first?
questions.background: Landfall occurs when a tropical cyclone's center crosses the coastline. This question concerns only mainland China.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official landfall reports from China’s National Meteorological Center, supplemented by contemporaneous reporting from major news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the province containing the location of Bavi’s first mainland-China landfall during July 2026. Subsequent landfalls do not count. If no qualifying landfall occurs during that month, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the province.

questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The province's name.

questions.title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
questions.background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting
  • Resolution Date: August 5, 2026
  • Accepted Answer Format: The state's name

questions.title: Which European country will declare a national emergency in response to wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements or reliable news reporting published by July 25, 2026.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the European country whose national government declares a national emergency because of wildfires between July 1 and July 25, 2026. Regional or local emergency declarations alone do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's commonly used English name.
questions.accepted_format: The country's commonly used English name.

questions.title: Which city will be the site of Typhoon Dolphin's first landfall in mainland China in August 2026?
questions.background: Dolphin developed into a typhoon over the Pacific in late July 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Landfall information issued by China's meteorological authorities, either directly or through contemporaneous reliable news coverage.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the city identified as the location of Dolphin's first mainland China landfall during August 2026. Offshore island landfalls do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.
questions.accepted_format: Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.

questions.title: Which country's mainland coastline will be confirmed contaminated by the Caroline Bezengi oil spill by August 13, 2026?
questions.background: The Caroline Bezengi has been leaking crude oil since running aground in June 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by government environmental authorities, or reliable news reports directly citing those statements.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve to the country whose mainland coastline is confirmed to have been contaminated by oil from the Caroline Bezengi by August 13, 2026. Offshore pollution, contamination confined to islands, and predictions of future landfall do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

questions.title: Which Indonesian province will be struck by the country's deadliest earthquake between January 1 and August 17, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the province identified as the location of Indonesia's deadliest earthquake occurring from January 1 through August 17, 2026. Determine the deadliest earthquake using fatalities reported by Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency as of August 17, 2026.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-08-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the province's name.

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
questions.background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country’s common English name.
